properties.description:
20 KW Kohler Installation
- Supply and install a Kohler 20 KW standby natural gas generator.  Generator to be located in rear of home between fence and air conditioning condenser. 
- Supply and install a pre-cast concrete pad for mounting of generator.
- Supply and install a Service Entrance rated, 200 amp Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS).
- Mount ATS in basement on adjacent wall from main panel. 
- Supply and install service cable from meter to ATS source 1 line-side taps.
- Re-feed main breaker panel with 150-amp sub-feeder.
- Rewire main breaker panel as a sub panel with grounds and neutrals separated.
- Supply all required grounding and bonding of service.
- Supply and install 100-amp sub-feeder from generator to ATS source 2 line-side taps.
- Supply a 15 amp, 120 volt house circuit for trickle charger and engine heater.
- Supply and install Belden communication cable from ATS to Generator.
- Supply and install Cat5e cable from the home network router/switch to the generator.
- Supply and install all necessary gas piping from gas meter, through basement soffit and out to rear of home. 
- Supply (1) low voltage relay for managing AC
- Supply (1) 50 Amp relay for managing large appliance.
- Configure the Kohler OnCue Plus monitoring system.
- Supply first year maintenance service, consisting of 2 visits, to provide manufacturer's required maintenance and other reliability testing. ($495 value)
- Kohler's 5-year limited warranty.

Panel Replacement
Replace 150-amp panel with 200-amp panel
- Shut down power at panel and remove meter.
- Remove service cable from main breaker panel.
- Remove main breaker panel.
- Supply and install a 200 amp, 30 space, main breaker load center.
- Reinstall service cable into new panel.
- Supply and install all required branch circuit breakers.
- Make all mains and branch circuit terminations.
- Identify circuits and place panel schedule.
- Re-install meter into socket, energize and test circuits.
NOTE:

properties.description:
We are going to install an 18KW Generac Generator at client’s residence. The generator will be located at least five feet from doors, windows, and vents to prevent carbon monoxide infiltration. We will ensure adequate clearance around the unit, minimum 18 inches on all sides, to ensure proper ventilation and access for maintenance. 
We will install 200AMP automatic transfer switch next to the electrical meter outside. The transfer switch will become the main panel and the existing main panel will become a subpanel.  We will connect the generator to the natural gas meter at the residence to provide fuel to the generator. 
After the installation, we will test the full system to ensure proper operation of the generator in the case of a power outage, and also ensure utility power supply to the house is not interrupted in any way. 
All work will be completed by our licensed electricians and plumbers.  Our company is fully insured.  Let us know if you have any questions. 

FISHING METHOD ONLY.

THUS, A NEW 1200A CIRCUIT CONNECTING PANEL "E" TO SWITCHBOARD "DB-1" SHALL BE PROVIDED FOR FUTURE USE. properties.description:
furnish & wire one 22kw Air Cooled Honeywell/Generac Electric Generator powered by liquid propane/natural gas operated engine. The 22kW generator will provide a 91.67 Amp rating for the total load setting. Install one Honeywell/Generac 200 Amp automatic transfer switch outside to the right of the 200amp meter socket. All branch circuits connected to the electrical panel will be transferred to the generator during the power outage condition and will have power availability simultaneously for the contents of the load center. The transfer switch will redirect all of the desired circuitry to the generator during a power outage condition.  This equipment will be located outside or wherever application is able to be installed to meet all the current electrical codes. Circuitry will not be transferred to the generator during the weekly exercise period, only during a power outage. Installation of the control wiring and connection points between the transfer switch and the generator equipment. This wiring will be installed for the equipment monitoring, automatic engine start function, exercise routine, power failure-alert, run time monitoring and battery charging equipment. This wiring will be routed from transfer switch outside through the entire length of the crawl space and trenched 25 to 30 feet over  to the location to the generator that will be 2ft off the bock of the pool house. All work to the 2014 NEC and with 
MP-2021-003242 for mechanical.
